svg.title: Computer Items Store — system architecture
svg.desc: Three-tier architecture: React frontend, Node.js/Express backend, MySQL/MongoDB database, with Payment Gateway and Delivery Service as external integrations.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the product listing page show?')
sendPrompt('How does the cart and checkout work?')
sendPrompt('What does the user dashboard show?')
sendPrompt('What does the admin panel manage?')
sendPrompt('How does JWT auth work in Express?')
sendPrompt('What does the product API endpoint handle?')
sendPrompt('How are orders and payments processed?')
sendPrompt('What does the delivery API do?')
sendPrompt('Show me the User and Product tables')
sendPrompt('How are orders and order items stored?')
sendPrompt('How are payments and deliveries stored?')
sendPrompt('How are reviews stored and queried?')
sendPrompt('How does the payment gateway integration work?')
sendPrompt('How does the delivery service API connect?')
